display.purpose: The landing introduction; a separate viewport clamp applies on phones.

headline.purpose: The room name and invitation heading.

title.purpose: Notes, mood and object section headings.

body.purpose: Messages, controls and supporting copy; size follows context.

motion.name: interaction
motion.purpose: Pointer hover and press feedback; hover runs only on devices that hover.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: Collapse animation and transition duration while preserving hidden content and action access.

components.name: Primary button
components.description: The main room or form action.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { font-family: var(--sans, "Nunito Sans", ui-sans-serif, -apple-system, system-ui, sans-serif); min-height: 44px; font-size: 15px; font-weight: 600; border: 1px solid var(--control, #998d7d); border-radius: var(--radius-control, 8px); padding: 12px 16px; cursor: pointer; transition: transform .16s ease-out, filter .12s ease; background: var(--honey, #566c4c); border-color: var(--honey, #566c4c); color: var(--on-honey, #fffdf4); } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--honey, #566c4c) 22%, var(--panel, #f9f8ef)); border-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--honey, #566c4c) 45%, var(--panel, #f9f8ef)); color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--ink, #2c4135) 75%, var(--panel, #f9f8ef)); cursor: not-allowed; }  .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2.5px solid var(--ink, #2c4135); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-primary:active:not(:disabled) { transform: scale(.985); } @media (hover: hover) { .ds-btn-primary:hover:not(:disabled) { filter: brightness(1.04); transform: translateY(-1px); } } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-btn-primary { transition-duration: .001ms; } .ds-btn-primary:active:not(:disabled) { transform: none; } }

components.name: Secondary button
components.description: An ordinary room action; selected actions gain an inset outline.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { font-family: var(--sans, "Nunito Sans", ui-sans-serif, -apple-system, system-ui, sans-serif); min-height: 44px; font-size: 15px; font-weight: 600; border: 1px solid var(--control, #998d7d); border-radius: var(--radius-control, 8px); padding: 12px 16px; cursor: pointer; transition: transform .16s ease-out, filter .12s ease; background: var(--panel, #f9f8ef); color: var(--ink, #2c4135); } .ds-btn-secondary:disabled { background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--honey, #566c4c) 22%, var(--panel, #f9f8ef)); border-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--honey, #566c4c) 45%, var(--panel, #f9f8ef)); color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--ink, #2c4135) 75%, var(--panel, #f9f8ef)); cursor: not-allowed; } .ds-btn-secondary[aria-pressed="true"] { border-color: var(--honey, #566c4c); box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px var(--honey, #566c4c); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2.5px solid var(--ink, #2c4135); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-secondary:active:not(:disabled) { transform: scale(.985); } @media (hover: hover) { .ds-btn-secondary:hover:not(:disabled) { filter: brightness(1.04); transform: translateY(-1px); } } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-btn-secondary { transition-duration: .001ms; } .ds-btn-secondary:active:not(:disabled) { transform: none; } }

components.name: Quiet action
components.description: Underlined access to notes, history and secondary room tools.
components.css: .ds-btn-quiet { font-family: var(--sans, "Nunito Sans", ui-sans-serif, -apple-system, system-ui, sans-serif); font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; color: var(--soft, #596b5d); background: none; border: none; cursor: pointer; display: block; min-height: 44px; padding: 12px 8px; text-decoration: underline; text-underline-offset: 4px; transition: transform .16s ease-out, filter .12s ease; } .ds-btn-quiet:disabled { opacity: .55; cursor: not-allowed; } .ds-btn-quiet:focus-visible { outline: 2.5px solid var(--ink, #2c4135); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-quiet:active:not(:disabled) { transform: scale(.985); } @media (hover: hover) { .ds-btn-quiet:hover:not(:disabled) { filter: brightness(1.04); transform: translateY(-1px); } } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-btn-quiet { transition-duration: .001ms; } .ds-btn-quiet:active:not(:disabled) { transform: none; } }

components.name: Text field
components.description: A clear, full-width field with phone-safe text size.
components.html: <label class="ds-field-label" for="ds-name">Your name</label><input class="ds-field" id="ds-name" placeholder="your name" />
components.css: .ds-field-label { display: block; margin-bottom: 10px; font-family: var(--sans, "Nunito Sans", ui-sans-serif, -apple-system, system-ui, sans-serif); font-size: 13px; font-weight: 650; color: var(--ink, #2c4135); } .ds-field { font-family: var(--sans, "Nunito Sans", ui-sans-serif, -apple-system, system-ui, sans-serif); font-size: 16px; width: 100%; min-width: 0; padding: 12px 14px; border: 1px solid var(--control, #998d7d); border-radius: var(--radius-control, 8px); background: var(--panel, #f9f8ef); color: var(--ink, #2c4135); } .ds-field::placeholder { color: var(--soft, #596b5d); opacity: 1; } .ds-field:focus-visible { outline: 2.5px solid var(--ink, #2c4135); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-field:disabled { cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Mood choice
components.description: A mood action uses pressed state and an inset selection outline.
components.css: .ds-mood { font-family: var(--sans, "Nunito Sans", ui-sans-serif, -apple-system, system-ui, sans-serif); font-size: 13px; min-height: 44px; min-width: 0; color: var(--ink, #2c4135); background: var(--panel, #f9f8ef); border: 1px solid var(--control, #998d7d); border-radius: var(--radius-control, 8px); padding: 10px 2px; cursor: pointer; transition: transform .16s ease-out, filter .12s ease; } .ds-mood[aria-pressed="true"] { background: var(--honey, #566c4c); border-color: var(--honey, #566c4c); color: var(--on-honey, #fffdf4); font-weight: 600; box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 2px var(--ink, #2c4135); } .ds-mood:focus-visible { outline: 2.5px solid var(--ink, #2c4135); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-mood:active:not(:disabled) { transform: scale(.985); } @media (hover: hover) { .ds-mood:hover:not(:disabled) { filter: brightness(1.04); transform: translateY(-1px); } } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-mood { transition-duration: .001ms; } .ds-mood:active:not(:disabled) { transform: none; } }

components.name: Note panel
components.description: A message gets a quiet tonal surface and a larger reading size.
components.html:
Aiden left this out for you

Put the kettle on. I’m glad you’re here.

a little while ago
components.css: .ds-note { padding: 15px 16px; border-radius: var(--radius-panel, 12px); background: var(--panel, #f9f8ef); color: var(--ink, #2c4135); font-family: var(--sans, "Nunito Sans", ui-sans-serif, -apple-system, system-ui, sans-serif); border: 0; } .ds-note-from { font-size: 13.5px; color: var(--soft, #596b5d); margin: 0 0 8px; font-weight: 500; } .ds-note-text { font-size: 17.5px; line-height: 1.55; margin: 0; } .ds-note-day { font-size: 12px; color: var(--soft, #596b5d); margin: 9px 0 0; text-align: right; }

components.name: Header utilities
components.description: The small wordmark and settings link share a quiet ruled header.
components.css: .ds-header { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 8px 14px; padding-bottom: 14px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line, #c6cfbf); color: var(--soft, #596b5d); font-family: var(--sans, "Nunito Sans", ui-sans-serif, -apple-system, system-ui, sans-serif); } .ds-brand { font-family: var(--display, "Bricolage Grotesque", "Nunito Sans", ui-sans-serif, -apple-system, system-ui, sans-serif); color: var(--ink, #2c4135); font-size: 27px; font-weight: 700; line-height: 1.1; letter-spacing: -.04em; } .ds-settings { display: flex; align-items: center; min-height: 44px; padding: 8px; color: var(--soft, #596b5d); font-size: 12px; font-weight: 700; text-decoration: none; } .ds-settings:hover { text-decoration: underline; text-underline-offset: 2px; } .ds-settings:focus-visible { outline: 2.5px solid var(--ink, #2c4135); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Room action dock
components.description: Four role-specific actions sit below the living scene.
components.css: .ds-dock { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(4, minmax(0, 1fr)); gap: 10px; max-width: 820px; margin-inline: auto; } .ds-dock-button { display: flex; justify-content: center; align-items: center; gap: 10px; font-family: var(--sans, "Nunito Sans", ui-sans-serif, -apple-system, system-ui, sans-serif); min-height: 44px; padding: 13px 10px; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; line-height: 1.4; color: var(--ink, #2c4135); background: var(--panel, #f9f8ef); border: 1px solid var(--control, #998d7d); border-radius: var(--radius-control, 8px); text-align: center; cursor: pointer; transition: transform .16s ease-out, filter .12s ease; } .ds-dock-button svg { flex-shrink: 0; } .ds-dock-primary { background: var(--honey, #566c4c); border-color: var(--honey, #566c4c); color: var(--on-honey, #fffdf4); } @media (max-width: 600px) { .ds-dock { gap: 6px; } .ds-dock-button { flex-direction: column; gap: 9px; padding: 12px 4px; font-size: 12px; min-height: 76px; } } .ds-dock-button:focus-visible { outline: 2.5px solid var(--ink, #2c4135); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-dock-button:active:not(:disabled) { transform: scale(.985); } @media (hover: hover) { .ds-dock-button:hover:not(:disabled) { filter: brightness(1.04); transform: translateY(-1px); } } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-dock-button { transition-duration: .001ms; } .ds-dock-button:active:not(:disabled) { transform: none; } }

narrative.overview:
The room feels small, private and lived in. Timber, ivory curtains, muted fabric and a compact
pixel cat provide the detail; the surrounding interface stays quiet and readable.

Sage day surfaces become forest green at night. Softly rounded controls and friendly, compact
headings support the authored scene without competing with it. [ART.md](ART.md) owns the
character and rendering rules; product behavior remains in the existing product and engineering docs.
keyCharacteristics: A living pixel scene with quiet interface chrome.
Sage and forest surfaces with cream and pale sage contrast.
Friendly headings, clear body text and restrained containers.

rules.name: The Shared Light Rule
rules.body: Use the live room tokens for interface surfaces and feedback. Do not freeze a daytime color inside a component that also appears at night.

dos: **Do** keep the cat and room interactive, customizable and crisp at every viewport.
**Do** use the live palette for text, controls and feedback in both room palettes.
**Do** keep role-specific actions, notes and editor ownership clear.
**Do** preserve keyboard controls, readable status and reduced-motion access.
donts: **Don't** use generated room images as runtime backgrounds or animation frames.
**Don't** stretch pixels or move furniture without moving its interaction geometry.
**Don't** turn every room section into a raised card.
**Don't** make moods or time away create neglect, decay or attendance pressure.
